text:
Jake DeBrusk is doing the job Vancouver brought him in for: shoot, and keep shooting. His 9.75 individual expected goals lead into a season pace of about 26 goals in our projection, and his 8 goals so far trail what his chances deserve by almost two. If anything, he's been unlucky with his own shot.

The rest of his game is harder to judge from the raw numbers. Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level last season, but noted he plays with weaker teammates and draws the other team's best, and with him on the ice this season the Canucks control more of the play than when he sits (+4.85 relative expected goal share at five on five). Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says 55% of his shots come off the rush.

He's also become the shootout guy. He won it against Minnesota on Nov. 21 with the soft flip under the bar that Daniel Wagner of Pass it to Bulis called "so cheeky." Four points in his last ten is quiet, but the shots keep coming.
